Use Skill(schedule). The selected skill is the single owner of project scheduling and output policy.

Runtime interface:
- checkout_mode: primary-checkout
- selected_skill: schedule
- selected_skill_path: /Users/neon/.codex/experiments/soodles18-implementation-20260916/installed-fa45a099/.agents/skills/schedule
- mise_input: /Users/neon/soodles/.noodle/mise.json
- promotion_input: /Users/neon/soodles/.noodle/orders-next.json
- canonical_orders: /Users/neon/soodles/.noodle/orders.json (read-only; the loop promotes atomically)

Supported compact transport schema (the selected skill may impose stricter project policy):
orders.json schema (JSON):
```json
{
  "action_needed": [
    "string - backlog item ID skipped pending user action"
  ],
  "initial_revision": "string (optional) - optional current order_revision from Noodle state.snapshot.json; requires every proposed ID to be absent. Stale/replayed proposals refuse before promotion. This is not execution authorization; omit only for the existing legacy scheduling contract.",
  "orders": [
    {
      "id": "string - order ID (plan ID as string, or unique slug)",
      "plan": [
        "string - linked plan path(s), e.g. plans/15-bootstrap-onboarding/overview"
      ],
      "rationale": "string (optional) - placement reason citing a rule or principle",
      "stages": [
        {
          "do": "string (optional) - task key (must match a task_types[].key from mise)",
          "extra": {
            "<key>": "JSON - opaque extension data preserved across round-trips"
          },
          "extra_prompt": "string (optional) - supplemental instructions for the cook on how to approach the task (max ~1000 chars)",
          "group": "number (optional) - parallel group ID; stages in the same group run concurrently, groups execute sequentially (default: 0)",
          "model": "string (optional) - model for this stage (optional; defaults from routing config)",
          "prompt": "string (optional) - full prompt text for the dispatched session",
          "runtime": "string (optional) - runtime for this stage (process, sprites, etc.)",
          "with": "string (optional) - provider for this stage (optional; defaults from routing config)"
        }
      ],
      "title": "string (optional) - brief order description"
    }
  ]
}
```

Constraints:
- Each order is a pipeline of stage groups executed sequentially. Stages within the same group run concurrently.
- Group related stages into one order rather than separate orders.
- Stage `do` values must match a `task_types[].key` from mise, or omit `do` and provide a `prompt` for ad-hoc stages.
- Each `rationale` should cite a specific scheduling rule or principle.
- Do not include `status` or `skill` fields — the loop sets these automatically.

Task types you may schedule:
- execute: Only the exact Issue/order admitted by the installed Soodles consumer.
